scope: Independent before-values primary-method/public-link/source/value/omission challenge of ONE proposed native EMC Ki67/MIB1 tumour-cell fraction versus mitotic-count comparison. No proliferation outcomes or rescue targets.
prospective_acceptance: Actual source-authenticated native EMC cases and matched explicit assay fields, specimen/ROI/timing/preservation/preparation mapping for all relevant conditions.
Named Ki67/MIB1 assay and tumour-cell counted denominator/selection; mitotic density field number/physical area/cellularity and definition; technical observers/replicates/uncertainty and comparators.
Useful unreported contrast beyond known grade/prognosis and generic cell-cycle fraction versus mitosis duration distinction; source-provided direct measurements needed.
Matched high Ki67/low mitotic count cannot by itself prove cell-cycle length, slow cycling, quiescence, apoptotic fate, drug dependency or treatment efficacy.
strongest_alternatives: Different ROIs/hotspots/sections and cellularity/area denominators could create apparent discordance.
Ki67 and mitosis sample different biological states; generic difference is prior knowledge, not novel EMC result.
Antibody/observer/cutoff variation, immune/stromal nuclei and biopsy-resection/treatment mixture could explain labels.
No direct paired assay fields or public matrix; pathology/IHC mention alone is insufficient.
first_source_gate: Read only primary title/methods/table headers/data availability/identity eligibility; all response/proliferation outcomes closed. Owner reports no Ki67/MIB1/mitotic field; independently reproduce literal/semantic method schema without declaring the tumour biologically lacks proliferation.
omission_rule: This is one concrete existing source gate. No new primary retrieval, marker hunt, numerical selection or global-corpus exclusion; if target fields absent, scoped source-dependent NO-GO. Genuine later source-linked measurement evidence can reopen only with useful prospective contrast.
restrictions: No denied FAP/glycan/HLA/structural content or dynamic RNA, imaging, circulating/staticRNA rescue; no private/logins/spend/outreach/publication/rootmutations/push. Post-ban quiet files only sufficient.
ownership: Only public_resource_omissions/distinct_primary_question_review; immutable previous science/freezes; Codex author+committer.
